input.summary: Narrow mutual non-solicit to involved personnel, 12 months post-involvement, with advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs
input.comment: [Playbook] We narrowed this mutual non-solicit to personnel directly involved in the Services for twelve months after their involvement ends, and added carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches; as drafted it barred solicitation of all employees for the whole Term, which is outside our position.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party during the Term of this Agreement, for any reason.
ops.newText: Neither party shall solicit personnel of the other party directly involved in the Services for twelve months after their involvement ends; general advertisements and unsolicited approaches are excluded.
